description: Reproducible on-device LLM benchmarks for Apple Silicon (iPhone 17 Pro, M4 Max): Apple Core AI vs MLX vs llama.cpp vs Core ML, same model, same harness — e.g. Qwen3-0.6B decode 181 tok/s (Core AI GPU) vs 112 (MLX) on iPhone 17 Pro; hybrid Mamba-2 models (Nemotron-3 Nano, Granite-4.0-H) included.
summary: Neutral, reproducible benchmark for local LLMs on Apple Silicon (Mac · iPhone · iPad) — MLX, llama.cpp, CoreML, Apple Foundation Models
